༄༅/ /gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha las byung ba'i khro bo rdo rje mchu'i ngag khrid zin bris bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha las byung ba'i khro bo rdo rje mchu'i ngag khrid zin bris bzhugs so//

gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐/ gnam chos rdo rje mchu yi sgrub thabs kyi// man ngag zhal shes nyams su blang bder 'god// sgrub gtor shing sder la sogs che ba'i nang*// zan ni gru gsum hom khung dbyibs can dmar// de steng gtor ma nag po zur gnyis pa// dpe 'u ris las byung ba ltar du bca'// rtsang dang dmar rgyan mi bya sha rgyan btsugs// stod ni khro bo smad ni mchod par dmigs// rgyun du las byang 'don dus gso bran bya// de yi mtha' skor ram ni gar bde ru// skyer pa'i rtsang thur btsugs pa'i kong zor dang*// sātstsha nag po phur pa mtho re tsam// tshwa dang cong zhi zhib btul khrag dang bsres// de la lcags phye btab nas yod na bzang*// de nyid rdo thun mang por byug pa dang*// de dag ser gta' bkram rgyu sngags phyir bzhag /gter gsar lugs 'dir sngags dang shog dril dang*// rdzas dang 'khor lo mi dgos zab khyad yin// 'on kyang de dag thon na bzang ba'i phyir// rakṣa zhes pa'i sngags de'i shog dril ni// gro ga la bris sātstsha'i nang du bcug /phur pa thung na phur pa'i rked par dkri// phur pa ring na 'chang gzung āḥyig dang*// 'chang gzung 'go mar oṃ dang 'og ma hūm̐// phur pa'i logs gsum srung sngags bkod bya ste// stod la oṃ dang sngags mjug phur rtser ston// logs gcig la ni oṃ nas kon gyi bar// gcig la tsa nas raṃ gyi bar du bri// gcig la gha nas kṣa yi bar du bri// phur pa thams cad btsag gis dmar por byug /yungs dkar thal chen sngags pa ras gtsang bstum// phur pa'i ske la tshon skud sna lngas bcing*// gro ga mchog yin shog gu 'thug po la// dbus su hūm̐ yig rtse la khrom yig bkod// de yi mtha' skor khro bo rdo rje mchus// yul 'di'i lo thog 'bras drug thams cad la srungs shig /ser ba ma gtang zhig /ces pa ser lam gcod pa'i 'khor lo ste// sgrub rten gtor ma'i rtse la btsugs rgyu la// rang gis bsrung rgyu'i grong pa thams cad kyi// ming rnams yul 'di zhes pa'i sa der bri// de rgyab mu khyud bsnyen sngags bri ba ste// de rgyab rtsibs bcu la ni hūm̐ yig re// de rnams yig mgo phyi la bstan pa ste// de rgyab mu khyud gdong zlog sngags bri ba// de ni yig mgo nang du bstan par bya// de rgyab mu khyud cung tsam che ba la// 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen padma dang*// rgya gram rnams ni phreng grangs med pa bri// yul kun bris la gtor ma'i rtse ru btsugs// gcig de gal che sa yi ser tho'i nang*// zor dang thun ni gdong zlog 'phen rgyu yin// shing ral dang ni gdong zlog sngags bri ste// shing ral yang ni ser lam bzhag rgyu 'o// gdong zlog sngags kyi mjug tu 'di yang bri// g.yas su byol cig

/g.yon du zur cig /glog mo'i lce chod/ 'brug mo'i sgra chog /ser ba dkar po'i rkang pa chog cig /sha laṃ bhri ti st+waṃ bha ya st+waṃ bha ya: u tsaṭṭa ya u tsaṭṭa ya: phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: ya ya sa tri ka tri: ru ru tsi ru sa ra ya dza dza: oṃ badzra ta ki ni tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa: ༈ ser srung snyan rgyud yi ge med pa ni/ sngags pa nus ldan gdung rus phye ma ni// sātstsha'i nang du bsre ba zab par brtsi// phag tshil chu dag sbrul tshil rtsang phag sha /gla rtsi btsan dug bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro /mu zi rkyang rtil dud pas ser ba chad// yang na rtsang pa'i sha dang sbrul sha dang*// phag tshil gu gul gla rtsi chu dag nag /gro phye bsres pa'i ril bu mang po 'tshag /dud pa things ba tsam gyis ser ba chad// yang na sre mong sha dang rtsang pa'i sha /rta bon rkyang bon mu zi nag po dang*// phag mo'i brun dang gu gul gla rtsi dang*// spyang brun ra thug lug thug rmang kha'i spu// dud pa things ba tsam gyis ser ba chad// ro ras sha chen gu gul se ba dang*// rgya skag mu zi yungs dkar ldong ros te// rdzas brgyad 'dzom na dud pa things bas chog /de dag rdzas kun 'dzom par dka' ba ste// gang 'dzom phyogs sdud byas la sngags nas 'tshag /nam yin mi bdug phog thug 'gro dogs yod// us thug mi thub shom dus zhad tsam bdug /ser gta' rdzas sna de dag sngon nas bsags// gtor mchod bcas la mtshams bsdam zhag bdun bsgrub// cho ga gcig gis bdag mdun dus gcig bsgom// bdug mdun phyi rol bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur pa// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng 'og rtsibs gnyis bcas// rtsibs rnams ral gri so gnyis rtse rno ltar// rtsibs nang rtsibs rtser rang 'dra'i khro bo bcu// 'khor lo'i nang ni sbub chal kha sbyor ltar// stong pa'i nang du bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsal// rtsibs rnams snga dro g.yas dang phyi dro g.yon// drag tu 'khor ba'i rtse mos gnod byed gtub// de rgyab 'khor lo chung ngu mang po 'brel// de rgyab rdo rje rin chen padma dang*// rgya gram me ri kha dog lnga ldan gur// de steng spyi gtsug thad kyi nam mkha' la// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa yi// dbus su shākya thub pa stong phrag bzhugs// rtsibs stong nang du bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*// bzhugs nas steng thog gnod pa srung bar bsgom// rang gi rkang zhabs g.yu yi grod pa ni// chen po rkang pas nem nem mnan yod bsam// de yis 'og 'khyug srung bar byed par bsam// mdun bskyed rdo rje mchu yi thugs ka ru// rang gi bsrung rgyu'i lo thog kun tshud bsgom// nyin phyed yan la bsnyen sngags swā hā can// nyin phyed nas gzung sngags 'dis ser gta' sngags// oṃ badzra dun to i ka ni kon:

tsa la ma la ti li raṃ raṃ: gha ru ṇaḥ.a ti ser ba srungs mi ti ser ba rakṣa: ser gta' thams cad khyung dang khro bor bsgom// de 'dra dpag med spyan drangs bstim bya zhing*// thun bzhir las byang bstod pa yan chad 'don// dgong mo'i thun la tshogs dang gtor 'bul bya// de ltar bsnyen tshad zhag bdun bsgrubs byas pas// mkhar las bzang po byas dang btsan sar 'dug /ra lug khyim du btsud dang shwa rags brtsig /nags tshal mthug po'i nang du 'dug pa dang*// zhing gi rib ma btsan po byas pa rmi// gzhan yang mtshan ltas bzang na 'grub pa yin// gzhung na med kyang sngags rgan gsung rgyun la// lug khyu ma thub rmis na ngan zhes zer// da rung sgrub pa zhag grangs bsring na legs// de ltar sgrub pa tshar nas ser bsang bya// yul de'i gzhi bdag drag rim ming nas 'bod// lo thog 'di dag khyed la bcol ba yin// ser ba ma gtong khyed kyis thub par srungs// mthu dang nus pa ci 'dug lta 'o brjod// de nas phur pa sātstsha mkhar sgong sogs// gang 'os so sor ser gta' bkram rgyu bskur// 'khor lo bltabs nas phying pa sogs kyis bstum// ser ba rgyun du 'ong ba'i ser lam gyi// ser tho'i nang du bzhag rgyu bskur bas chog /sātstsha 'khor lo chu yis mi 'jig bya// ser tho rnams kyang khro bo khyung bcas bsgom// rgyun du las byang 'don dus bskyed bstim bya// ser gta' rnams la bud med mi reg bya// dam tshig rang dang sde yis bsrung bya gnyis// rang gi phreng ba gzhan gyis lag mi 'grim// phyi sha mi za mgo la mar mi bku /sla ngar brdzis pa'i zas ni mi za zhing*// mna' rdzun mi smra sla nga mgor mi gyon// sme can dam nyams kha 'phro 'thung mi rung*// sgrub tshe sngags tshig gzhan gyis ma tshor bya// ser ba srung tshe gdams ngag spel mi rung*// mi gtsang gos sme gon par mi bya 'o// sde yis bsrung bya mna' gnyan skyel len dang*// nya dang sbal sbrul phyi ba gsod mi rung*// shing gnyan gcod dang chu mig nel seng rlog

/glang dang rnga bran bsha' bar mi rung ngo*// 'dzing rtsod ngu 'bod klu shing mer mi bcug /ser ba sngags dus sngags pa'i ngor mi lta/ khyi dang bu med sngags pa'i rtsar mi gtang*// sngags pa'i sngon du ra lug mi 'ded cing*// ser ba sngags stangs mi rung dam tshig yin/ ༈ /de nas dus dang dus min ser ba gnyis// tshes bzhi'i snga dro sprin ni ser nag byung*// tshes brgyad phug ron ske yi mdog 'dra'i sprin// bcu gcig ra ma rgya mo'i sbo 'dra dang*// bco lnga kham nag thal ba gnam stor 'dra// bco brgyad rta skya'i rnga ma gyen bshad 'dra// nyi shu sprin dmar sems can gzugs 'dra ba// nyer dgu sprin ni dud kha mgo che ba// de dag ser ba'i dus yin sngags dmigs sgrim// dus min sprin ni rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dang*// dung brtsegs 'dra na ser sprin yin pas sngags// g.yu 'brug 'dra na phyi 'phrad 'ong ba'i rtags// dkar po sran ma gtor 'dra phyir nyin 'ong*// dkar po dung 'dra'i dkyil du gzugs brnyan 'dra// phyir nyin 'am ni srod la 'ong ba yin// ra ma rgya mo'i sbo 'dra dma' zhing 'khrugs// rmugs chen byung na 'phral du 'ong ba yin/ khang rming sa rdul 'dra na de ma thag /nam mkha' skya dang 'od de 'phral du 'ong*// phub rul thal ba gtor 'dra phral du 'ong*// dud kha bang rim chags pa 'dra ba dang*// sprin kun dma' zhing 'khrug na 'ong ba yin// 'brug ni rkang pa'i 'og nas grags 'dra dang*// gram rdo chad 'dra 'brug skad yang yang chad// glog ni dma' zhing khyim du 'khyug 'dra dang*// sprin ni thal ba 'dra zhing dma' la 'khyug /'brug sgra che zhing nam mkha' gsal la skya// nam mkha' mthing nag 'brug sgra glog kyang myur// sprin dal rlung 'tshub ka ra ra byed na// nyi ma phyi dro mun 'tshub dus la 'ong*// sprin dkar 'phang mtho rlung drag shed che na// nyi ma phyed yol man gyis ser ba 'ong*// dud kha sems can gzugs 'dra klu yin te/

kham nag rlung 'tshub 'brug glog che ba na// bdud kyi ser ba mun 'tshub nam phyed 'ong*// ser po rlung 'tshub skor skor btsan gyi yin// sprin nag nam mkha' skya la 'tshub ma 'ong*// lha srin sde brgyad 'dus pa'i ser ba yin// sprin nag thad dkar 'khyil zhing gzhan rnams dwangs// de ni gza' yi ser ba yin par bshad// de ltar ser ba bcas nas byung ba'i dus// de la kha gyus sngags ni mi rung ste// sde brgyad khrag skyug gza' yi lto ba 'gas// rang nyid sde brgyad kun dang 'gras tshab che// de phyir ser sprin la ni rgyab rten bsngags// phyi ltas byas la phu dang sdigs mdzub bya// phyag g.yon rlung 'tshub spros pas ser sprin gtor// phyag g.yas me dpung 'bar bas ser ba bzhus// ser sprin byung nas bzung ste gdong zlog sngags// 'di nyid drag tu brjod cing sngags par bya/ oṃ badzra dun to i ka ni kon: tsa la ma la ti li: ser ba mā ra ya phaṭa: zlog zlog: gnod byed ser ba ser byed dang bcas pa dzwa la raṃ raṃ: ser sprin gtor ma thub cing 'khrigs bsdad na// lcags phye bsres pa'i thun ni yod na 'phang*// lag g.yas rdo rje'i phyag rgya byas nas kyang*// ser lam ston pa'i sngags 'di brjod bya ste/ oṃ badzra dun to i ka ni kon: tsa la ma la ti li: ser ba bhyo bhyo dhi ra bhyo 'dir bhyo: zhes pa'i sngags ni de yi mjug /lo thog med pa'i sa phyogs su// nags tshal che na 'di nyid sbyar/ nags ri la rgyob ya choms/ spang ri che na 'di nyid sbyar// spang ri la rgyob ya yoṃ: brag ri che na 'di nyid sbyar// brag ri la rgyob ya hoṃ: rdza ri che na 'di nyid sbyar*// rdza ri la rgyob ya yā: mtsho 'am chu chen yod pa na/ chu la rgyob ya yā: zhes pa gang rung sham bu gcig sbyar gyis// thams cad sbyar ni mi rung ngo*// de phyogs rdo rjes lam bstan pas// ser ba de ru 'gro bar 'gyur// gal te ser rkang btsugs byung na// yod na shing ral g.yug bya ste// med na ral gri'i phyag rgya g.yug

/gnam lcags ngar ma'i ral gri yis// ser ba'i rkang pa bcad par bsgom// lag pa khyung gi phyag rgya byas/ khyung gis gshog pas ser sprin rnams// gshag cing me yis bsregs par bsgom// des ma thub na thun dang zor/ khro bo khyung bcas me 'bar bsgom// ser ba'i gdong du brgyab pa yis// ser ba ser byed gzhob par bsgom// rdo rje'i 'gros byas phur pa 'dril// ser 'bru khar bcug gnam du stor// shin tu thu na zhwa gos brdab// rten gtor 'phang pas the tshom med// de nas ser ba yal ba dang*// nyams len stong nyid ngang la bzhag ༈ /de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su// rang nyid kha sar pa ṇi'i sku /nam mkha' khyab pa'i phyag g.yas kyis// mchog sbyin mthil nas hrīḥdakar las// bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mdog lta bu// chu bo chen po'i rgyun bzhin bab// lha 'dre kun la khrus byas pas// snad yar smad 'gram byung ba gsos// bdud rtsi 'thung bas ngom zhing tshims// thal mo sbyar nas chos nyan bsgom// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lha 'dre rnams la chos sbyin dang*// 'bu srin rnams la skyabs kyi sbyin// rtsam zan rnams la zang zing sbyin// sems can kun la byams pa'i sbyin// ser srung sbyin pa rnam bzhi 'dis// bla med byang chub 'bras thob shog /ces brjod bsngo ba smon lam bya// thog chod skya ni zham pa'i dus// gtang rag bsang mchod thon na legs// tshogs dang mchod gtor rgyas par 'bul// gtang rag legs so thon na ni// de phyir srung yang sla ba yin// ser gta' rnams kyang bsdus na legs// rab gnas spar nas phyir lo bkram// gal te bsdu bar ma grub na// rjes chog skabs su dmigs pas bsdu// bstims pa'i lha rnams gshegs gsol bya// de dag thams cad rdo rje mchu/

kho na'i gzhung nas byung ba ste// rdo rje mchu yi rtsa sngags mjug /ga ru ṭaḥhaṃ sa tsa le tsa le swā hā: yor ge ga ge sad: baṃ baṃ sad: raṃ raṃ sad: phur phur sad: pra mu ti sad: ces pa'i shog dril bris nas kyang*// rang sngags de yis ci 'grub sngags// ser dung la ni dkris te bcing*// bus pas ser ba thub par bshad// sir sgra tsir sgra grags pa 'am/ rmi lam mgar tshang mgar byed mthong*// nyams snang lcags rdung sgra thos na// thog ni 'ong ba'i ltas yin pas// thog dmigs gzhung du gsal ltar las// ni nā ga dza mun ti a: de nyid cung zad bzlas pas thub// mthing shog la ni gser gyis bris// rang sngags des sngags btag pa na// thog srung de las zab pa med// rang byung ba dang o rgyan gsungs// de gnyis gzhan nas kha bskangs byas// lha btsun sngon mo'i gter ma yi// rdo rje mchu ni rgyas na yang*// gter rnying dbang lung brgyud pa dkon// 'khrugs che phal gyis lag len dka'// sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje la/ khro bo nyid kyis gsungs pa'i phyir// brgyud pa nye zhing rno ba yin// de sngon thub pa'i lag blangs mang*// 'on kyang 'don 'grigs phyag len bcas// gsar bu rnams la phan pa'i phyir// 'di yi dbang lung thob phyi nas// dpe cha yod pas chog pa 'di// gter blon rā ga a syas bsgrigs// dge slong brtson 'grus can gyis bris// nyes 'gal ser bdag rnams la bshags// dge bas rtsam zan mi rnams la// mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin par shog /maṅga laṃ/// /
༈ zur gnyis mdun 'bur dod kyis dkyil gshong*/ gdan zan gru gsum/ mar rgyan dang rtsang mi btsugs/ hom khung dmar/ gtor ma nag po ma thon zan mdog rung*/
